artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body portrait of a young child in an ornate frame with draped fabric. The child has a round face, closed lips, and short hair under a decorative hat. They wear a luxurious outfit with a fur-trimmed coat, patterned sleeves, and a detailed dress. The child's hands rest on a cushion and a tassel-like object. The background features heavy, gathered fabric, with coats of arms at the top of the frame and an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a young child in elaborate dress holding a scepter and a branch of flowers. The child wears a plumed hat, a decorated dress with a lace collar, and a pearl sash across the chest. The oval frame surrounding the portrait features Latin text. The background includes tapestries with fleur-de-lys and mythical creatures.

artworks.title: Louis XIII of France
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a boy seated upright on a horse. He is dressed in a detailed outfit with a wide-brimmed hat and is holding the reins with one hand raised. The horse is embellished with a decorative saddle cloth. The background shows a scenic landscape with hills, buildings, clouds, and a decorative crest in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.artist: Léonard Gaultier after Jacques Sébastien Le Clerc
artworks.description: The image shows a young royal figure standing. The person has one hand on a cushioned table and the other hand on their hip. The individual has a neutral expression and styled, wavy hair. They are wearing royal attire including a doublet, puffed breeches, knee-high boots, a sash, and a belt. Beside them on the table is a crown, a rolled document, and regal emblems. In the room, there is a high-backed chair and a small dog near the person. The background features an ornate tapestry with fleur-de-lis motifs and richly decorated drapery.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person standing in a frontal position, slightly turned to their left. The face has round features with distinctive eyes and a small mouth. The individual has short hair hidden under a large hat. They wear a high-collared garment with intricate patterns and a sash across the torso. The clothing appears elaborate, suggesting formality and status. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Louis XIII of France
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait of a young man in an oval frame, facing slightly to his right. He has a neutral expression, youthful features, smooth skin, full lips, and short curled hair. He wears an intricately designed outfit with a high lace ruff around his neck and a richly decorated garment. A crown sits on his head, and he wears a pendant around his neck. The background includes line engravings, and the image is surrounded by an ornate oval border with text and inscriptions.

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.description: The illustration features a person seated on a rearing horse, holding a baton. The individual wears armor and a cape, and a plumed helmet on the horse's head. The person has curly hair, a small beard, and a turned expression. The background shows hills, and there is French text at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Louis XIII of France
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in a formal pose, featuring his upper body. The man has distinct facial features, curly hair, and is dressed in ornate noble attire, including a ruffled collar, cloak, and breastplate. In the background, there is text in a circular border, and beneath the portrait is engraved poetic text.

artworks.title: Louis XIII of France
artworks.description: The image features a detailed engraving showing a central bust portrait of a man, facing forward with a serious expression. He has curly hair, a high lace ruff, and wears an ornate garment with a star-shaped emblem on his chest. Surrounding him is an elaborate frame with floral motifs, cherubs, and classical figures. Cherubs adorn the top, and below the portrait is an inscribed scroll with medallion portraits. The background includes classical pillars and intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.artist: Jeremias Falck after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image features a three-quarter view portrait of a man from the waist up. The man is slightly facing to the left while looking directly at the viewer. He has long, curly hair, a mustache, and goatee. He is wearing an elaborate robe with embroidered details and a high collar. In his right hand, he holds a large scepter, and a sword is visible to his left. The background is detailed with symbolic elements like a crown above the portrait, shields, a lion, and celestial motifs in round frames on either side. There are emblems and a globe present, enhancing the intricate setting and symbolism surrounding the central figure.

artworks.title: Louis Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a historical portrait shown waist up. He faces forward with a slight turn to his left. The man's features include a stern expression, a broad forehead, a mustache, and curly hair reaching near his shoulders. He wears armor with engravings and a large collar. His left hand holds a baton across his body. In the background, there are stone column-like structures and a sky with clouds. The image includes an inscription with text.

artworks.title: Princess Louisa, Daughter of Henry Frederick
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving showing an upper body portrait of a young woman named Loisa van Oraengien en Nassaw. She is facing slightly to her right with her head and gaze directed towards the viewer. Her facial features have soft contours, including large eyes, a straight nose, and a small closed mouth. Her shoulder-length hair flows away from her face, partially hiding a headdress. She wears ornate clothing with lace detailing, a collar with lace, ribbons on the bodice, and a pearl necklace. The background has a stippled pattern, providing contrast to the figure. The portrait is within an oval frame with text indicating the year and context.

artworks.title: Her Royal Highness Princess Louisa Anne
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a young girl identified as Her Royal Highness Princess Louisa Anne. She is depicted facing forward, with her head slightly tilted upward, displaying a direct gaze. The girl has delicate facial features with wide-set eyes, a small nose, and a subtle, closed mouth expression. Her hair is light in color and styled neatly with a lacy headpiece. She is dressed in a richly decorated dress with intricate patterns and ruffled lace trim along the neckline and sleeves. The fabric of the dress looks ornate, suggesting formal or royal attire. The background is dark and neutral, emphasizing the girl's features and clothing details. An armchair she is seated in is partially visible in the frame, providing context to the setting.

artworks.title: Louise Juliana of Nassau, Electress Palatine
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a woman facing slightly to her left with a soft expression and small lips. She is adorned with a large lace ruff around her neck, a dress with floral patterns and buttons, and accessories such as earrings. Latin text surrounds her within a circular frame, and there is additional text or inscription at the lower part of the image. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Louise Juliana, Wife of Frederick IV
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to her left. Her facial features include a solemn expression, high forehead, and arched eyebrows, with her gaze directed towards the viewer. Her hair is styled high with intricate detail and is surrounded by an elaborate adornment resembling a crown or ornate headdress. She is wearing a detailed dress with a high, ruffled collar and puffed sleeves, adorned by intricate patterns. Around her neck hangs a large pendant on a chain. The background is a heavily patterned surface, and the portrait is encased within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions around the edge.

artworks.title: Louise Juliana, Wife of Frederick IV
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a woman in a frontal position. She has a long face with almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and a small, closed mouth. Her hair is styled high with a decorative headpiece. She wears an ornate garment with a large ruff collar, a necklace with a square pendant, and the background is a textured oval. The portrait has inscriptions and decorative elements. Text provides historical information, and there is a note indicating her birth year, 1576, and the year of death, 1644.

artworks.title: Saint Ignatius de Loyola, Founder of the Jesuits
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile, in a prayerful position with his hands clasped together, and appearing to hold rosary beads. He has a prominent forehead, a well-defined nose, a short beard, and short hair. He is wearing a high-collared garment or robe that suggests clerical clothing. To his right is a crucifix with the figure of Christ. In the background is a monogram displaying "IHS" with a radiant design around it.

artworks.title: Saint Ignatius de Loyola
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man, likely Ignatius of Loyola, in a three-quarter view facing left. His facial features include a prominent forehead, high cheekbones, closely shaved scalp with a fringe of hair, mustache, and chin beard. He appears contemplative with deep-set eyes, dressed in a high-collared religious habit. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscriptions and symbolic imagery, including a light-filled shape near his head. Surrounding the portrait are four scenes: one of a figure praying, one of a man in bed with a celestial figure above, and two with religious iconography. The image has a classical, formal appearance with intricate detailing typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Saint Ignatius de Loyola
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of an individual, capturing the figure from the chest upwards. The person is positioned facing slightly toward the right of the image. He has a thoughtful expression with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair appears to be short and is largely concealed by a distinct, wide-brimmed dark cap. He is dressed in formal, traditional attire that includes a high-collared garment. The background consists of fine lines creating a simple textured backdrop. There is a block of text below the image.

artworks.title: St. Ignatius de Loyola
artworks.description: The image is a detailed engraving of the upper half of a man's body in profile, facing right. The man is standing with hands clasped together in prayer. He has a calm expression, with a bald crown, short hair, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a robe with a high collar, and has a radiant halo encircling his head. He wears a ring on his right index finger. In the foreground, he is looking at a crucifix with an image of Jesus Christ, to the right. Below the crucifix is a human skull resting on books. The background is plain, placing emphasis on the central figure and objects.

artworks.title: St. Ignatius de Loyola
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man, likely a historical figure, facing slightly to the viewer's left. The man is presented in three-quarters view, wearing a religious garment or cassock with a high collar and a distinctive cap. His facial features include pronounced cheekbones, a serious expression, and a short beard and mustache. His hands hold an open book with visible Latin text. The man's clothing is a detailed vestment with large folds. The background features crosshatched engraving, with the initials "IHS" and a heart encircled in rays of light or clouds in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Saint Ignatius de Loyola
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright with a solemn expression. He has a round face, short hair, and trimmed facial hair. The man is wearing an ornate religious robe with intricate patterns, extending down to his feet. One hand is raised and the other rests on an open book with the words "AD MAIOREM DEI GLORIAM." He has a halo around his head and there are clouds, light, and an "IHS" emblem in the top right corner. The background is plain, emphasizing his robe and the imagery.

artworks.title: Madame Lvebout
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of a person within an oval frame. The person is facing forward with a stoic expression, defined cheekbones, and slightly pointed chin. They have long dark hair covered by a draped headdress, and wear a high-collared garment with lace details. The background is a shaded oval with no visible objects. The image is monochrome with detailed lines.

artworks.title: Martin Luther
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person with a round face, broad forehead, high cheekbones, and short, curly hair under a soft cap. The individual is facing forward with a slight turn to the left and wearing a high-collared garment and a cloak. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is plain with text panels above and below the portrait, with the lower panel indicating the person's name and age.
